keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Maxime Delanghe (Willem II).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Groningen 0, Willem II 1. Calvin Twigt (Willem II) left footed shot from more than 35 yards to the high centre of the goal.
First Half ends, Groningen 0, Willem II 1.
